description: Suite-level routing set for the customer beancount-* skills. Each entry names the one skill that should handle the prompt, or `none` when no suite skill should. `confusable` lists skills the prompt could be mistaken for: an entry is a near-miss negative for every confusable skill other than its expected one. Validated by scripts/ci-check.py; run against real clients with scripts/run-routing.py (never in CI).

entries.prompt: How much did I spend on groceries last month?
entries.why: A spending question answered from the local ledger.

entries.prompt: What's my net worth right now according to my ledger?
entries.why: Balance-sheet question; read-only.

entries.prompt: Which of my subscriptions went up in price this year?
entries.why: Recurring-merchant trend question.

entries.prompt: What were my top five expense categories in 2026?
entries.why: A ranking query, not a period close or report commit.

entries.prompt: How many transactions did I import from Chase last month?
entries.why: Counts entries already in the ledger; nothing is imported.

entries.prompt: Let's do the month-end close for September.
entries.why: The month-end ritual by name.

entries.prompt: Wrap up the books for last month and commit the result.
entries.why: Closing a period and committing it.

entries.prompt: Reconcile all of my accounts for June, check the flags, and close the period.
entries.why: Multi-account reconciliation plus close is the close skill's orchestration, not one-account reconcile.

entries.prompt: Import this Chase CSV into my ledger: ./downloads/chase-activity.csv
entries.why: A bank CSV export into an existing ledger.

entries.prompt: I downloaded a QFX file from my credit union. Can you record it in my books? It's ./export.qfx
entries.why: OFX/QFX export import.

entries.prompt: Record the transactions from my Amex export ./amex.csv
entries.why: Card export import.

entries.prompt: Import ./chase-oct.csv the same way as last time; the source is already set up in my ledger's import config.
entries.why: A repeat import uses the stored config; no importer needs writing.

entries.prompt: Write a beangulp importer for my Schwab checking CSV exports so I can rerun it every month. Sample: ./schwab-sample.csv
entries.why: A reusable, tested importer from a sample file.

entries.prompt: My importer for Ally broke because they renamed the CSV headers. Can you fix it?
entries.why: Repairing an existing importer after format drift.

entries.prompt: I've imported this bank's CSV by hand four times now. Turn it into a real tested importer I can run myself.
entries.why: Graduating a repeated import into code.

entries.prompt: Set up a new beancount ledger in this folder.
entries.why: Scaffolding a fresh ledger.

entries.prompt: I want to start plain-text accounting. Create a fresh ledger here in USD with no history.
entries.why: A new ledger with nothing to migrate.

entries.prompt: Bootstrap a beancount repo with Fava so I can browse it in my browser.
entries.why: init's optional Fava setup.

entries.prompt: Mint shut down and I have a CSV export of all my transactions. Move my history into beancount.
entries.why: Finance-app history into a fresh ledger.

entries.prompt: Convert my Monarch Money export into a beancount ledger.
entries.why: Finance-app export conversion.

entries.prompt: Migrate my QuickBooks Online transactions into a new ledger.
entries.why: QBO history migration.

entries.prompt: Import my full Mint history into a new ledger.
entries.why: Says import, but full finance-app history into a new ledger is a migration.

entries.prompt: Create a new ledger and bring in my Monarch export.
entries.why: Migration composes init; the history is the point.

entries.prompt: I sold a cash-secured put on AAPL, 150 strike expiring June 20, for 1.50. Record it.
entries.why: An options trade to record.

entries.prompt: My covered call on MSFT got assigned yesterday. Book it in my ledger.
entries.why: An options lifecycle event.

entries.prompt: Record this fill: Sold to Open 1 SPY Dec 19 '26 600/590 put spread @ 2.10
entries.why: A pasted broker confirmation for a multi-leg trade.

entries.prompt: Does my checking account match the bank statement for May? ./may-statement.csv
entries.why: One account against one statement.

entries.prompt: Reconcile my Amex against this statement PDF: ./amex-june.pdf
entries.why: Statement reconciliation from a PDF.

entries.prompt: My savings balance in the ledger doesn't match what the bank shows. Compare it with ./statement.csv.
entries.why: A balance discrepancy against a statement.

entries.prompt: Here is my June checking statement. Add whatever transactions are missing and assert the ending balance. ./june.csv
entries.why: Missing entries plus a balance assertion is reconcile, not a bulk import.

entries.prompt: Reconcile my checking account for June.
entries.why: One account, not the whole close.

entries.prompt: Close my old Amex card account in the ledger. I cancelled the card.
entries.why: Closing one account is a `close` directive, not a period close.

entries.prompt: Mark Assets:Bank:OldSavings as closed as of today.
entries.why: A `close` directive, not a period close.

entries.prompt: Set the operating_currency option in my ledger to EUR.
entries.why: A Beancount `option` setting, not an options trade.

entries.prompt: Which beancount options should I set at the top of my main file?
entries.why: Ledger `option` directives (documentation), not options trading.

entries.prompt: How do I use a beancount option to rename the Assets and Liabilities roots?
entries.why: The `name_*` options; documentation.

entries.prompt: Explain how a covered call works and whether I should sell one.
entries.why: Options education and advice; the options skill records trades only.

entries.prompt: What are the greeks on my AAPL 150 put?
entries.why: Pricing and greeks are out of every skill's scope.

entries.prompt: What does `bea ask` do, and how is it different from `bea query`?
entries.why: A question about the CLI, not about the ledger.

entries.prompt: How do I write a BQL query that groups by month?
entries.why: General BQL documentation.

entries.prompt: What is the difference between a balance and a pad directive in beancount?
entries.why: General Beancount documentation.

entries.prompt: I paid $42 for dinner on the Amex tonight. Add it to my ledger.
entries.why: One manual purchase.

entries.prompt: Add a transaction: $1,200 rent paid from checking on the 1st.
entries.why: One manual bill payment.

entries.prompt: Open a new account Assets:Bank:HighYieldSavings in my ledger.
entries.why: An `open` directive in an existing ledger, not a new ledger.

entries.prompt: Fix the typo in the payee of yesterday's Starbucks transaction.
entries.why: Editing an existing entry; every skill appends only.

entries.prompt: My ledger is hosted on Beancount.io and I'm connected through its MCP server. What did I spend on dining last month?
entries.why: A hosted ledger; the local skills do not apply.

entries.prompt: Using the Beancount.io MCP connection, close the month for my hosted ledger.
entries.why: A hosted ledger; the MCP server has its own close-month prompt.

entries.prompt: My books live on Beancount.io (MCP connected). Reconcile my checking account against ./june.csv.
entries.why: A hosted ledger.

entries.prompt: Record a $250 transfer from checking to savings today.
entries.why: A transfer between the user's own accounts, entered by hand.

entries.prompt: Here's my receipt: Costco 2026-10-12, groceries 84.10, household 31.55, paid with the Amex. Book it.
entries.why: A split purchase from pasted receipt text, not an export file.

entries.prompt: Add a price to my ledger: 1 VTI = 285.40 USD as of today.
entries.why: A price directive.

entries.prompt: I got paid $3,200 salary into checking on Friday. Record it.
entries.why: One income entry.

entries.prompt: Add a $42 dinner to my ledger on Beancount.io through the MCP connection.
entries.why: A hosted ledger.
